title: 第一章 狼窝第二章 决战教皇
lines: 2011年，一款由美国riotgames开发的英雄对战moba竞技网游重新定义了游戏，一经登陆中国就掀起了一股史无前例的电竞风暴。
它的名字是&ldquo;英雄联盟&rdquo;。
上海浦东某幸福小区的18号六楼，敞开的窗口传来了一阵阵吼声。
&ldquo;上，上，上，一波，一波，狼哥这手锐雯简直秀的惨无人道啊！&rdquo;
&ldquo;nice，nice，杀ad杀ad，好，冲冲冲！&rdquo;
&ldquo;又是躺赢局，我就说不要让狼哥玩中单。&rdquo;
一波狂吼，耳机里传来振聋发聩的欢呼声，李牧忍不住把耳机拉远一点，一把常规胜利也能让这帮家伙这么兴奋。
&ldquo;淡定，淡定！&rdquo;
&ldquo;狼哥，这次十二连环坞的这帮小子该服气了吧，打到他们服为止！&rdquo;
&ldquo;这帮家伙根本不知道老狼只用了五成功力就荡平了他们。&rdquo;
李牧也是哭笑不得，&ldquo;你们都是要打职业的人了，别一惊一乍的，要有牌面。&rdquo;
&ldquo;哈哈，狼哥就是我们最大的牌面，无论将来到了哪儿，我们都是狼队的人！&rdquo;
现在最流行的一款游戏就是英雄联盟，火遍全球，前所未有，同时中国的电竞市场也在争议中前行，涌现了一批职业偶像，比以前实在是好太多了。
耳机里的欢呼声渐渐平静下来，大家有点伤感，他们是艾欧尼亚的业余战队&ldquo;杀破狼&rdquo;，圈子称之为狼队，自从李牧加入后，这已经是第n次拿到战队排名第一了，狼窝也成了业余圈子里最神秘强大的地方，由于战绩出色，其他几个人都接到了职业战队的邀请，今天是大家的告别赛，同时又把排名第二的十二连环坞狠狠教育了一番。
十二连环坞，是由国服王者排名前30的12名玩家组成的战队，一经组建便轰动了整个国服的高分段玩家，本以为能雄霸天下，却年年成为狼队的垫脚石，这不，刚刚黄金联赛的决赛又被吊打，十二连环坞不服气，私下里约了团战，结果被打的更惨。
&ldquo;狼哥，虽然不知道什么理由，但希望有一天能在职业赛场上碰到你，无论队友还是对手，这段时间从你身上学到了很多！&rdquo;说话的是打野，&ldquo;贪狼&rdquo;成封，我的野是我的，你的野也是我的，绰号等同于对野怪的渴望。
&ldquo;老狼，你干嘛这么神秘，线下聚会从来不参加，难不成&hellip;&hellip;你是个小姐姐？？？&rdquo;中单&ldquo;独狼&rdquo;霍然笑道。
&ldquo;靠，有嗓门这么粗的小姐姐吗，独狼，你口味也太重了！&rdquo;
&ldquo;是啊，我总觉得他不一定是年纪最大的，不会是骗我叫他哥吧，那我就亏大了！&rdquo;adc小夜笑道，他的id是白天不懂夜的黑，这年头，年纪越小的越是多愁善感。
&ldquo;老狼，有事儿记得群里q兄弟们，没事儿也多勾搭我们&hellip;&hellip;&rdquo;&ldquo;母狼&rdquo;大飞是上单，又当爹又当妈，其实年纪也才17.
众人一阵絮叨，都有点不舍，加入职业队之后就不可能像现在这么随意自由了，整个狼队固然有天赋，但说真的，发生质变完全是因为狼哥的加入，哪怕对于即将成为职业选手的他们也对神奇的队长有着各种好奇。
李牧的id是&ldquo;你们看不见我&rdquo;，平时大家都叫他狼哥，在进入战队一个月之后，贪狼就把队长的位置让给了他，兄弟们对他都是心服口服，对于他现在还没能加入职业，大家其实也挺好奇的，当然也都猜测他志不在此。
李牧微微一笑，在狼窝里打字：祝兄弟们前程似锦，咱们江湖再见。
狼队的四个队友现在都收到了职业队试训邀请，adc小夜更是直接和传奇战队woe签约，那是涌现了电竞四天王的明星战队，16岁，国服第一德莱文，前途无量啊。
今儿，自诩钢铁直男的李牧有点感慨了，天下没有不散的宴席，但总会有重聚的一天。
放下耳机，李牧无奈的揉了揉脑袋，不想职业？
开玩笑！准确的说他是太想了，做梦都想，虽然咬牙拼了个大学，但李牧知道自己几斤几两，完全是老天爷打瞌睡了，他的民诉挂科了两年了，在沪政属于鄙视链的最底层生物。
这段时间他早就给lpl所有战队甚至下级联赛lspl都发了邮件，可是基本石沉大海，唯一回复的是一个来自lspl战队：兄弟，多大年纪了还浪费我们时间，还等到毕业，你是逗比吗，知不知道我们很忙，心里没点数儿嘛&hellip;&hellip;
&hellip;&hellip;懂不懂得尊老啊，拿不到毕业证，他老妈一定会砍死他的，这个也就罢了，重点是那个合同也还没到期啊。
一想到合同，李牧的思绪不由得有点飘飞，时间一下子回到了五年前。
那是2008年的冬天，天气格外的冷，上海竟然下雪了，此时浦东金阳街一个大型网吧中，应该正是人声鼎沸热闹非凡的时候，可此时偌大的网吧静悄悄的，但打开门却发现整个网吧已经人满为患，所有人都围在大屏幕前仰着头，个个面色凝重。
这个时代什么电竞项目最火爆，毫无疑问星海争霸，从全球范围来说，韩国对于这个项目是占据统治地位的，拥有绰号教皇、狂君、神主还有六暴龙的顶尖选手，大有称霸宇宙的意思，可是他们却在上一届的scg1v1国际争霸赛上铩羽而归，丢掉了冠军，当然韩国媒体认为这是因为他们根本没有重视，所以这次这一次他们派出了豪华阵容捍卫自己的霸主地位。
然而，过程却不是他们预料中的轻松，scg第二届的决赛正如火如荼的进行中，交手的双方是来自中国的16岁天才少年killer。

killer这个id在中国电竞圈可是大名鼎鼎，出道即巅峰，很小的时候就在格斗游戏上大展拳脚，这两年更是统治国内星海争霸圈，获得多项冠军，尤其是取得去年的scg冠军，一鸣惊人，而这个年纪，意味着他的未来拥有无限的可能性，此刻killer的对手则是来自韩国星海争霸联赛的人族王者教皇look，此时的look基本已经完成对这个游戏的制霸，被称为星海毁灭者，强到摧毁游戏的意思，同样的，他所在的电竞豪门sk已经连续三年垄断冠军了，在竞争激烈残酷的电竞世界堪称奇迹。
content_en:
In 2011, a hero battle MOBA competitive online game developed by American riotgames redefined the game. Once it landed in China, it set off an unprecedented e-sports storm.
Its name is "League of Legends".
On the sixth floor of No. 18, a happy community in Pudong, Shanghai, waves of roars came from the open window.
"Up, up, up, one wave, one wave, Brother Lang's hand on Riwen is simply inhumane!" ”
"Nice, nice, kill ad, kill ad, okay, go, go, go!" ”
"It's another win-win game, so I said don't let Brother Lang play the mid lane. ”
A wave of roars and deafening cheers came from the earphones. Li Mu couldn't help but pull the earphones away. A regular victory could make these guys so excited.
"Calm down, calm down!" ”
"Brother Lang, it's time for these guys in the Twelve Links Dock to be convinced this time. Beat them until they are convinced!" ”
"These guys didn't even know that Old Wolf only used 50% of his power to defeat them." ”
Li Mu also didn't know whether to laugh or cry, "You are all going to be professionals. Don't be surprised. You have to have your cards right." ”
"Haha, Brother Wolf is our biggest card. No matter where we go in the future, we will always be members of the Wolves!" ”
The most popular game now is League of Legends, which is popular all over the world like never before. At the same time, China's e-sports market is also moving forward amid controversy, and a number of professional idols have emerged, which is much better than before.
The cheers in the headphones gradually calmed down, and everyone was a little sad. They were Ionia's amateur team "Sha Po Lang", known in the circle as the Wolf Team. Since Li Mu joined, this is the nth time that the team has been ranked first. The Wolf's Den has become the most mysterious and powerful place in the amateur circle. Due to their outstanding performance, several others have received invitations to the professional team. Today is everyone's farewell game, and at the same time, they gave a hard education to the second-ranked Twelve Links.
Twelve Lianwu is a team composed of 12 players ranked in the top 30 of the national server kings. Once formed, it caused a sensation among high-level players in the entire national server. They thought they could dominate the world, but they have become a stepping stone for the Wolves every year. No, they were defeated again in the finals of the Golden League. Twelve Lianwu was not convinced and arranged a team battle in private, but they were beaten even worse.
"Brother Lang, although I don't know the reason, I hope to meet you in the professional arena one day. Whether a teammate or an opponent, I have learned a lot from you during this period!" The one who spoke was the jungler, "Greedy Wolf" Cheng Feng, my wild is mine, your wild is mine too, the nickname is equivalent to the desire for wild monsters.
"Old Wolf, why are you so mysterious and never attend offline gatherings? Could it be that... you are a young lady?" ? ? "The mid laner "Lone Wolf" said with a smile.
"Damn, is there a young lady with such a loud voice? Lone Wolf, you have too strong taste!" ”
"Yes, I always feel that he is not necessarily the oldest, and he is not lying to me to call him brother. Then I will be at a big loss!" "adc Xiaoye said with a smile, his ID is that he doesn't understand the darkness of night during the day. These days, the younger he is, the more sentimental he is.
"Old Wolf, if you have something to do, remember to ask the brothers in the group. If you have nothing to do, try to hook up with us..." "She Wolf" Da Fei is the top laner. He is both a father and a mother. In fact, he is only 17 years old.
Everyone was chattering for a while, and they were all a little reluctant. After joining the professional team, they would not be as free and free as they are now. Although the entire Wolves team is talented, to be honest, the qualitative change happened entirely because of Brother Wolf's joining. Even they who were about to become professional players were curious about the magical captain.
Li Mu's ID is "You Can't See Me", and everyone usually calls him Brother Lang. A month after joining the team, Greedy Wolf gave him the position of captain. The brothers are all convinced by him. They are actually quite curious about him not being able to join the profession yet, and of course they all guess that this is not his ambition.
Li Mu smiled slightly and typed in the wolf's den: I wish brothers a bright future, and we will see you in the world.
The four teammates of the Wolves have now received invitations to trial training with the professional team. Adc Xiaoye has directly signed a contract with the legendary team woe, which is a star team with the emergence of the Four Kings of e-sports. At 16 years old, Draven is number one in the national server. He has a bright future.
Today, Li Mu, who calls himself a straight man, feels a little emotional. There is no banquet in the world, but there will always be a day of reunion.
Putting down the headphones, Li Mu rubbed his head helplessly, didn't he want to be professional?
joke! To be precise, he thought so much that he even dreamed about it. Although he gritted his teeth and worked hard to get into college, Li Mu knew how much he weighed. It was because he had dozed off. He had failed the civil complaint test for two years, and he was at the bottom of the contempt chain in Shanghai politics.
During this period of time, he had already sent emails to all teams in LPL and even the lower league LSPL, but basically nothing happened. The only reply came from the LSPL team: Brother, how old are you to waste our time and wait until graduation? Are you kidding me? Do you know that we are very busy and have no idea...
...Do you know how to respect your elders? If he can't get his diploma, his mother will definitely hack him to death. That's all. The important thing is that the contract hasn't expired yet.
When he thought about the contract, Li Mu's thoughts couldn't help but wander a little, and time suddenly returned to five years ago.
It was the winter of 2008, the weather was extremely cold, and it actually snowed in Shanghai. At this time, a large Internet cafe on Jinyang Street in Pudong should have been bustling with people. However, the huge Internet cafe was quiet at this time, but when I opened the door, I found that the entire Internet cafe was already overcrowded. Everyone gathered in front of the big screen with their heads raised, and everyone looked solemn.
Which e-sports event is the most popular in this era? There is no doubt about Star Wars. From a global perspective, South Korea is dominant in this event. With top players nicknamed Pope, Mad Lord, God Lord and Six Tyrannosaurus, they have great ambitions to dominate the universe. However, they failed in the last SCG1v1 International Competition and lost the championship. Of course, the Korean media believed that this was because they did not pay attention at all, so this time they sent a luxurious lineup to defend their dominance.
However, the process was not as easy as they expected. The second SCG finals were in full swing. The two sides were competing against Killer, a 16-year-old genius from China.
Killer is a well-known name in the Chinese e-sports circle. He has been at the top since his debut. He has been showing off his talents in fighting games at a very young age. In the past two years, he has dominated the domestic star sea scene and won many championships, especially last year's SCG championship, which was a blockbuster. And this age means that his future has unlimited possibilities. At this moment kil ler's opponent is Look, the king of the human race from the Korean Star Ocean League. At this time, Look has basically completed his dominance of the game. He is called the Star Ocean Destroyer. He is so strong that he means to destroy the game. Similarly, his e-sports giant SK has monopolized the championship for three consecutive years, which is a miracle in the fiercely competitive and cruel e-sports world.
title_en: Chapter 1: Wolf's Den Chapter 2: Decisive Battle with the Pope
